findings.summary: Default run scene is enhancement test instead of approved separate main menu.
No persistent campaign save, continue metadata, or unresolved irreversible result recovery was found.
Enhancement test, game flow, and lifecycle PoC own separate in-memory state.
Legacy grade ids and labels conflict with the approved five-tier grade canon.
Legacy three-slot decade milestones conflict with lineage plus two secondary affixes and the two +50 routes.
Automation can cross identity and high-risk decisions with random precision and missing materials.
Customer and request flow is hardcoded to Kyle and an exact iron sword instead of four archetypes with multiple named customers and category requests.
Combined broken-or-lost state, global relationship, and gladiator-only outcomes cannot represent the approved model.
Irreversible results are fragmented and are not persisted before presentation.
The working visual board contains placeholder level, gem, shop, achievements, special crafting, inventory capacity, and location implications.
Active start documents retain pre-merge PR #35 state.
Base v8, v9.1, and v9.3 references are simultaneously active.
Runtime-built GDScript UI lacks reusable Theme and visual Scene boundaries.
Fixed widths and offsets are used and no product safe-area handling was found.
The visual settings panel is not implemented or persisted; only two PoC toggles exist.
Pause, background, process death, and Android back behavior are undefined.
Six-slot session storage and the placeholder 128/150 capacity do not support the approved equipment identity and ownership model.
General sale, visiting merchant, and named customer channels are not separated.
Equipment history and per-customer relationship presentation are insufficient.
Current validators and tests strongly protect legacy customer, grade, and affix schemas.
The Android game exit button policy is unresolved.
Market and arena images could incorrectly imply direct exploration or combat.
Mascot brightness, scale, and motion have not been validated on actual screens.
Final fonts, icons, art provenance, and Asset Ledger are not fixed.
No screenshot baseline or visual regression workflow exists for the four core screens and state variants.
Telemetry does not cover main entry, continue, recovery, +50 routes, customer archetypes, or ResultEnvelope comprehension.
